purpose: Defines requirements for the orchestrator pattern in forge skills: delegation to skills and agents, self-contained reference docs, parallel execution, data exchange, document formats, and completion flow.
summary: Background: God-Skill problems (context consumption, reduced instruction following, no parallelism, loss on compression)
Target skills using orchestrator plus delegation: start-design, start-plan, start-implement, start-requirements, review
FNC-001: user-invocable skills are orchestrators; document search goes directly to query skills without an intermediate Agent
FNC-003: reference documents given to agents must be self-contained and placed in plugins/forge/docs/
FNC-004: independent work runs in parallel; agents return results as return values; data exchange by identifiers and script-written JSON
FNC-005: document format selection, JSON for machine-processed plans and Markdown for requirements and designs
FNC-006: common completion flow of review with --auto, ToC update, and commit
FNC-007: user input interpretation is done by AI, not by argument-parsing scripts
Applicability table of data exchange methods per skill
tasks: Designing or modifying a forge orchestrator skill
Designing agent data exchange between orchestrator and agents
Choosing a document format for forge artifacts
Implementing completion processing of document-generating skills
Reviewing skills for argument parsing policy
title: REQ-001 オーケストレータパターン要件
